title: The Kings' Rest, Hollowbrook offered 'lay the Keeper's Key on the hearth-stone' (rest) right next to 'shatter the hearth-stone' (burn) with no third option to simply leave and use the key elsewhere — but the key's own item text later says it also opens 'the pilgrims' stair at Coldpass,' so choosing to burn here may have foreclosed a use I never got to test.
